title: Battle of Thermopylae
description:
The **Battle of Thermopylae** was fought in 480 BC during the Persian Wars. King Leonidas I led 300 Spartans and allied Greek forces against the massive Persian army of Xerxes I.

Despite being vastly outnumbered, the Greeks held the narrow pass for three days before being outflanked. The battle became a symbol of courage against overwhelming odds.

The sacrifice of Leonidas and his men bought time for Greece to prepare its defenses.
